```{r}
library(nichenetr) 
library(Seurat)
library(SeuratObject)
library(tidyverse)
library(DiagrammeRsvg)
library(circlize)
library(ggraph)
library(tidygraph)
library(ggnetwork)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
setwd("D:/HLHS/2024 final version/total interactions circos plots")
```

```{r}
NF_total_interactions <- read.csv("D:/HLHS/2024 final version/nichenetr endocardium circos/split by condition/NF/endocardium_ligand_to_targets_total_interactions.csv")

SysHF_total_interactions <- read.csv("D:/HLHS/2024 final version/nichenetr endocardium circos/split by condition/SysHF/endocardium_ligand_to_targets_total_interactions.csv")

bcell_mast_df <- data.frame(receiver = c('bcell', 'mast'), count = c(0,0))

SysHF_total_interactions <- rbind(SysHF_total_interactions, bcell_mast_df)

SysHF_total_interactions_temp <- SysHF_total_interactions[order(SysHF_total_interactions$receiver),]

rownames(SysHF_total_interactions_temp) <- 1:nrow(SysHF_total_interactions_temp)

SysHF_total_interactions <- SysHF_total_interactions_temp

rm(SysHF_total_interactions_temp)
rm(bcell_mast_df)
```

```{r}
total_interactions <- bind_rows(NF_total_interactions, SysHF_total_interactions) %>%
  group_by(receiver) %>%
  summarise(count = sum(count, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
```

```{r}
color_key <- c('endothelium' = '#920000',
               'fibroblast' = '#004949',
               'cardiomyocyte' = '#009292',
               'myeloid' = '#ff6db6',
               'pericyte' = '#490092',
               'endocardium' = '#006ddb',
               'tcells' = '#24ff24',
               'smc' = '#FFA500',
               'lymphatic' = '#b66dff',
               'adipocyte' = '#6db6ff',
               'neuron' = '#E3E300',
               'bcell' = '#ffb6db',
               'mast' = '#b6dbff')
```

#total interactions graph
```{r}
# Create edges data frame and add a self-loop for endocardium
edges <- total_interactions %>%
  mutate(sender = "endocardium") %>%
  rename(from = sender, to = receiver) %>%
  select(from, to, count)

# Define nodes data frame
nodes <- unique(c(edges$from, edges$to))
nodes_df <- data.frame(name = nodes)

# Create a graph object
graph <- tbl_graph(nodes = nodes_df, edges = edges, directed = TRUE)

# Plot using ggraph
ggraph(graph, layout = 'circle') +
  geom_edge_arc(aes(width = count),  # Adds a curved line with weight based on count
                color = color_key['endocardium'],  # Set all arrows to endocardium's color
                arrow = arrow(length = unit(4, 'mm')), 
                end_cap = circle(3, 'mm'),
                curvature = 0.1) +  # Reduced curvature for less intense curves
  geom_node_point(aes(color = name), size = 5) +
  geom_node_text(aes(label = name), repel = TRUE) +
  scale_edge_width(range = c(0.5, 2)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = color_key) +
  theme_void() +
  labs(title = "Endocardium Interactions with Recipient Cell Types NF and SysHF") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r}
png(filename = "./total interactions circle plot no labels.png", width = 10, height = 10, units = "cm", res = 300)
ggraph(graph, layout = 'circle') +
  geom_edge_arc(aes(width = count),  # Adds a curved line with weight based on count
                color = color_key['endocardium'],  # Set all arrows to endocardium's color
                arrow = arrow(length = unit(4, 'mm')), 
                end_cap = circle(3, 'mm'),
                curvature = 0.1) +  # Reduced curvature for less intense curves
  geom_node_point(aes(color = name), size = 5) +
  scale_edge_width(range = c(0.5, 2)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = color_key) +
  theme_void() +
  labs(title = "Endocardium Interactions with Recipient Cell Types") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
dev.off()
```

```{r}
NF_interactions <- read.csv("D:/HLHS/2024 final version/nichenetr endocardium circos/split by condition/NF/endocardium_ligand_to_targets.csv")

SysHF_interactions <- read.csv("D:/HLHS/2024 final version/nichenetr endocardium circos/split by condition/SysHF/endocardium_ligand_to_targets.csv")
```

```{r}
NF_CCN2 <- subset(NF_interactions, ligand == "CCN2")
NF_NRG3 <- subset(NF_interactions, ligand == "NRG3")

SysHF_CCN2 <- subset(SysHF_interactions, ligand == "CCN2")
SysHF_NRG3 <- subset(SysHF_interactions, ligand == "NRG3")
```

```{r}
CCN2_NF_SysHF <- rbind(NF_CCN2, SysHF_CCN2)
NRG3_NF_SysHF <- rbind(NF_NRG3, SysHF_NRG3)
```

```{r}
CCN2_interaction_counts <- CCN2_NF_SysHF %>%
  group_by(receiver) %>%
  summarize(count = n()) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
NRG3_interaction_counts <- NRG3_NF_SysHF %>%
  group_by(receiver) %>%
  summarize(count = n()) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
CCN2_NRG3_interactions <- bind_rows(CCN2_interaction_counts, NRG3_interaction_counts) %>%
  group_by(receiver) %>%
  summarise(count = sum(count, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
```

```{r}
null_df <- data.frame(receiver = c('cardiomyocyte', 'bcell', 'adipocyte', 'tcells', 'pericyte', 'neuron', 'mast'), count = c(0,0,0,0,0,0,0))
```

```{r}
CCN2_NRG3_interactions <- rbind(CCN2_NRG3_interactions, null_df)
```

```{r}
CCN2_NRG3_interactions <- CCN2_NRG3_interactions %>% arrange(receiver)
```


```{r}
# Create edges data frame and add a self-loop for endocardium
```
